title: PAR-134 MLINESTYLE CMC DWG retention with scalar-only DXF projection guard
mode: generated AC1024 DWG object-vector and focused ASCII/Binary DXF fast slice
scope: Replay already-retained MLINESTYLE fill and element CMC fields to DWG without dropping method, RGB, flags, or optional names
Validate all fill and element CMC values before writing body, detached strings, or handles
Keep class-specific MLINESTYLE DXF colors limited to the documented scalar group-62 projection

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: ODA defines R2004+ CMC as a reserved BS index, packed BL method/value, RC optional-name flags, and optional color-name/book TV strings. MLINESTYLE uses CMC for fill and each line color, followed by angles, line count, offsets, and versioned linetype fields; R2018+ uses linetype handles.

autodeskMlineStyleDxf.finding: The class-specific DXF reference lists group 62 for fill and element colors, with the MLINESTYLE field schema; it does not list truecolor or CMC color-name/book groups. The typed DXF writer therefore remains scalar-only and refuses richer retained CMC state.

localCode.finding: The MLINESTYLE parser already retained fill and element CMC values, but its DWG encoder admitted only scalar ACI-style state and wrote index-only colors. The DXF writer already had a class-specific loss guard; existing controls were promoted to a focused CTest.

productionSummary: Preflight scalar/RGB agreement, source method, optional-name flags, bounded names, version compatibility, and detached-stream availability for fill and every element before emitting bytes.
Encode supported C0-C3 CMC using the method-aware DWG writer, retaining raw optional-name flags including flagged-empty strings; retain legacy index-only output before AC1018.
Keep MLINESTYLE DXF output restricted to group-62 scalar colors and reject RGB, names/books, invalid flags, and unsupported source methods before publication.

generatedControls.wireWalk: An independent AC1024 body/string cursor reads the style name/description, C0 flagged-empty fill, C2 named RGB element, C1 book-only element, C3 named ACI element, angles, element count, offsets, and signed linetype indices.
generatedControls.parserRetention: The production object parser reads the generated frame and checks CMC metadata, subsequent fields, parent handle, and copy/assignment/reset. An independently walked common-handle stream checks owner, null extension dictionary, and a following sentinel.
generatedControls.unsupportedMethod: A generated CMC wire mutation changes the fill method to C5 with the documented scalar fallback value; parsing retains C5, and DWG rewrite refuses before output. This mutation is not evidence of producer-authored MLINESTYLE C5 payload semantics.
generatedControls.failClosed: Direct writer controls reject unsupported C5, unknown flags, inconsistent name/book flags, missing detached storage for flagged-empty metadata, and out-of-range RGB before body/string/handle output. Focused ASCII/Binary MLINESTYLE controls continue to reject CMC state that group-62-only DXF cannot represent.

validation.strictBuild: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors_tests libdxfrw_wave1_tests dwg2dxf lc3_compat_check -j4
focusedCommands: git diff --check -- CMakeLists.txt src/drw_objects.cpp tests/dwg_object_vectors_tests.cpp DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md

evidenceLimits: Generated vectors establish local wire/parser/writer consistency only; no independent DWG producer was used.
The C5 mutation checks source-method retention and fail-closed rewrite, not producer payload semantics.
DXF behavior remains the documented scalar projection; no truecolor or optional-name group mapping was added.
No persistent fixture, native CAD application, independent semantic route, full suite, platform qualification, or support promotion was used.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
The shared worktree remains broadly dirty; this slice is uncommitted and unstaged.
